comments.author: Daniel
comments.body: This is simply called ' Dorado' on the discoveries list in game.

comments.author: BonnyLass
comments.body: Aye, and you can only find it with fishing skill in the Paraguay River Upstream landing zone. I caught one with just R10 fishing right away, while a company colleague with R17 had to try for a few minutes.

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: It's in the Paraguay River Upstream as BonnyLass stated, in the pond in the very southeast part of the map.
